action_assessment.capital_risk_and_total_return_check: Assume cash 25m, debt 50m, no refinancing in five years and EBITDA 100m. Price risk remains: at a 10% income hurdle Bear DPS 3.2 supports 32, 20% below the assumed price 40. Flat DPS gives 10% annual cash income at 40, not a guaranteed total return; sale price and reinvestment are uncertain.

cash_flow_model.starting_metric: OCF after cash interest and tax
cash_flow_model.proxy_reconciliation: Base FY2026: OCF 130m - maintenance 20m - other owner claims 10m = Owner FCF 100m; deduct committed growth 20m and mandatory uses 5m once to reach recurring FAD 75m; exceptional cash use 5m leaves distribution capacity 70m.
cash_flow_model.capital_and_remittance_evidence: Assume all cash is at the ordinary parent and distributable, with no restricted subsidiary cash, regulatory remittance cap or preference claim. Cash 25m and debt 50m are fictional starting balances; no scheduled debt maturity in the five-year model.

coverage_summary.comparison_basis: Fictional FY2021-2025 full fiscal years, USD millions, ordinary cash distributions 40m each year; no special dividend, scrip or repurchases.
coverage_summary.shortfall_funding_and_limitations: FY2025 actual capacity 35m versus cash dividend 40m required 5m from pre-existing unrestricted cash; recurring FAD 90m covers the payout. The one-year cash deficit is disclosed, not erased by normalization.

business_outlook.management_execution: Assume management delivers funded capacity on time and maintains the 40% earnings payout. Cancellation or payout policy changes require a new forecast.

scenario_theses.Bear: Volume/revenue and all proportional operating and cash lines are 20% below Base; earnings payout percentage and share count unchanged.
scenario_theses.Base: Revenue 500m, profit 100m and OCF 130m in FY2026; 2% annual volume growth thereafter, with stable margins/capital intensity.
scenario_theses.Bull: Volume/revenue and proportional operating and cash lines are 20% above Base; no multiple expansion or higher payout ratio.

business_outlook.fcf_change_decomposition: Revenue, earnings and all cash bridge lines use one explicit scenario factor: Bear 0.8, Base 1.0, Bull 1.2; multiply by 1.02^(year-1) for 2% annual volume growth with constant margins and capital intensity.
business_outlook.per_share_cash_outlook: No shares are issued or repurchased; 10m dividend-entitled shares each year. Payout is 40% of attributable earnings, not 40% of FAD.
business_outlook.liquidity_and_self_funding: Base year 1 distribution capacity 70m exceeds dividend entitlement/cash cost 40m by 30m; every scenario scales both cash and payout equally, so no modeled funding gap.

cumulative_fad.limitations: Sum of the explicitly modeled annual recurring FAD; not annualized investor return, and not cash after dividends.

business_outlook.extension_limitations: Years 4-5 are explicit teaching assumptions, not issuer guidance. The 2% volume path is conditional on funded capacity and stable conversion; all capital spending scales with output.

milestones.event: Renew service contracts and deliver the funded capacity plan
milestones.observable_threshold: Volume and OCF conversion no more than 10% below scenario plan; capacity delay no longer than one year.
milestones.source_to_revisit: A real application must obtain the next annual report and contract/capex update; this company is fictional.
milestones.fcf_implication: A lasting miss changes recurring FAD and funded DPS; a one-year timing miss changes dated growth PV only if later capacity is unchanged.
milestones.action_if_missed: Rebuild assumptions before any purchase decision.

payout_policy.basis_definition: 40% of ordinary-parent attributable earnings in the same fiscal year; no special dividends.
payout_policy.source_and_date: Fictional board policy assumption A3 dated 2026-01-01.
payout_policy.funding_constraint: Dividend entitlement and actual cash cost must each fit distribution capacity. Year 1 Base: 100m profit x 40% = 40m dividend versus 70m capacity.

return_requirements.benchmark_source: Teaching assumption A5 dated 2026-01-01; 4% is not a fetched Treasury quote.
return_requirements.tax_and_fx_basis: USD reporting, USD quote and USD shareholder cash; FX 1. Assume zero shareholder withholding, fees and personal tax for this fictional case only. Real tax/custody status must be verified independently; this is not an HK resident tax conclusion.
price_independent_risk_factors: 4 percentage points lower premium for renewal/operating risk; 6 points upper premium adds cash conversion and concentration stress. Neither depends on price or score.
return_requirements.limitations: The 8%-10% nominal total-return range is a teaching input. The ordinary income thresholds give no growth credit and do not establish full business intrinsic value.

income_assessment.reason: No investor or established portfolio income target was supplied; show the 10% forward net yield but leave yield fit Not Assessed.

growth_assessment.evidence_and_reason: Conditional fictional direct operating-to-DPS bridge: 2% output growth, unchanged conversion and payout, fully scaled maintenance/growth spend, no dilution or cash-remittance limits. All five forecast years and year 6 terminal funding reconcile; Medium confidence is not Strong Buy permission.

holding_review.rationale: No actual holdings, account constraints or alternative investment were provided; do not invent a sale or position size.
